title: Primjedbe
body:
Prostor za pisanje teksta je premaleni, trebalo bi kao i u izvornom programu - Wunderlist, u trenutku početka pisanja povećati se na veličinu formata A4. 
Kod pretraživanja treba prikazati osnovne mape kao prioritet. Sada kod pretraživanja dobivate hrpu raznih prijedloga koji se prikazuju na jedan neobičan, zbrčkan načina. 
Inače aplikacija je vrlo korisna.
author: JB.Zgb

title: Sort tasks by completed date
body:
Hi team,
App is good free alternative for pro apps, but it lacks some basic options.
Like sorting completed tasks by completed date. It’s not normal to sort completed tasks by due date, not useful.
Also creating tasks and selecting due date and alarm date and time is somehow very slow, it should be on same page to select due time and alarm date.
Keep good work.
author: ..edin..

title: To make it better...
body:
Please make the following changes:
- set user’s own default bell sound
- allow entering of 14:30 instead of 2:30 PM for those who want
- repeat the sound after 5 or maybe 10 minutes if the user didn’t hear the sound the first time
- allow duplicating of one reminder at different times chosen by the user

Thanks,
Davor
